members.mistake: accept when p > q: the draft token is accepted exactly when p is bigger than q at its token, with no coin, so a token whose q is at least its p is always rejected
accept with p/q but resample from p: a rejected token is replaced by a token picked from p itself and not from the residual (p - q)+
resample from q: a rejected token is replaced by a token picked from the draft model's own q and not from the residual (p - q)+
an off-by-one in the residual: the excess of each token is written one place along, wrapping at the end of the vocabulary, so the token that replaces a rejected one is the one after the right one

the boundary-inclusive comparison of SGLang PR #35798: <= where < is right, in the accept step and in the walk over the weights, so one coin too many is accepted and a draw that lands on a boundary goes to the token before it
a FLy-style lossy rule: a token that is rejected at a flat target is kept anyway when the next draft token would be accepted, so the output drifts from p toward q
